<!-- For depth-0 pages only (currently just index.qmd). Reads the page's main
     content aloud via the same free browser speechSynthesis API used on
     lecture slides and activity pages — see js/text-to-speech.js. -->
<div id="website-read-aloud-mount"></div>
<script src="js/text-to-speech.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  if (!window.TextToSpeech) return;
  var btn = TextToSpeech.createReadAloudButton(
    function () {
      var el = document.querySelector("#quarto-document-content");
      return el ? el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : "";
    },
    { label: "🔊 Read this page aloud", className: "page-read-aloud-btn" }
  );
  var mount = document.getElementById("website-read-aloud-mount");
  if (btn && mount) mount.appendChild(btn);
})();
</script>
